en.summary: This commit fixes the collector-to-GPR response path by explicitly terminating ready on always-ready response stages and by separating that path onto a dedicated GPR interface.
why_it_counts: It changes the active RTL path that returns operand values from the GPR banks back to operand collectors.
The patch repairs handshake semantics on intermediate response buffering and routing stages.
The response-path bug is portable to other collector or register-file return networks even though the commit also includes interface cleanup.
disqualifiers: A substantial part of the diff is interface renaming and signal cleanup around the same response path.
evidence: In VX_gpr_unit.sv, pipe_reg1 changes from leaving ready_out unused to tying ready_out to '1.
In VX_gpr_unit.sv, rsp_xpoint also changes from leaving ready_out unused to tying ready_out to '1.
The same commit introduces a dedicated VX_gpr_if interface and rewires VX_opc_unit.sv and VX_operands.sv to use it for this path.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A register-read return network often has intermediate pipeline buffers and a response crossbar even when there is no downstream backpressure. Those stages still need an explicit always-ready sink. If ready is left unused, floating, or implicitly dependent on tool behavior, valid operand responses can stall, disappear, or propagate unknown handshake state back into the collector path.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Operand collectors issue GPR reads and responses return through intermediate buffers or a response crossbar that should be permanently ready.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the explicit always-ready termination on the response pipeline or crossbar so ready becomes unused or non-deterministic.
portability_notes: This applies to any operand collection path where register-bank responses are routed through internal stream primitives.
The mutation is most appropriate when the design intends those internal stages to be sink-like and never backpressure the response.
You can reproduce the bug without changing register-bank storage semantics; only the response handshake termination needs to be corrupted.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the internal pipeline buffer or crossbar that carries register-read responses back to operand collectors.
Identify outputs whose ready should be permanently asserted because there is no downstream throttling at that point.
Delete or disconnect the explicit ready tie-off so those stages no longer see an always-ready sink.
Leave request generation and storage-array reads intact so failures show up as missing or stuck operand returns.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: GPR response pipeline and response crosspoint handshake termination
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix ties ready_out to '1 on the response pipe buffer and response crosspoint in VX_gpr_unit.sv, while also moving this path onto the dedicated VX_gpr_if interface.
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: remove always-ready tie-off on response stages
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In hw/rtl/core/VX_gpr_unit.sv, revert pipe_reg1.ready_out and rsp_xpoint.ready_out from '1 back to unused or disconnected outputs.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Operand collectors stop receiving some register values, wait indefinitely for responses, or see unstable response handshakes that lead to incorrect operand assembly.
evidence_for_injection: Both changed ready_out connections are on the return path from GPR banks to collectors.
The commit does not alter the actual RAM data contents; it alters the response transport semantics.
The dedicated VX_gpr_if introduction shows the designer was isolating a specific register-read request and response channel.
notes: The interface rename is supporting context; the primary reinjectable bug is the missing always-ready termination on response stages.
Because rename noise is mixed with the fix, confidence is kept at medium.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 collector 到 GPR 的响应返回路径：为本应始终 ready 的响应阶段显式终止 ready，同时把该路径拆成专用的 GPR 接口。
why_it_counts: 它修改了把操作数值从 GPR bank 返回给 operand collector 的实际 RTL 路径。
该补丁修复了中间响应缓冲和路由阶段上的握手语义。
尽管提交里还带有接口清理，但这个响应路径错误本身可以迁移到其他 collector 或寄存器文件返回网络。
disqualifiers: 该差异中相当一部分是围绕同一路径进行的接口重命名和信号清理。
evidence: 在 VX_gpr_unit.sv 中，pipe_reg1 从原先未使用 ready_out 改成把 ready_out 直接接到 '1。
在 VX_gpr_unit.sv 中，rsp_xpoint 也从未使用 ready_out 改成把 ready_out 接到 '1。
同一提交还引入了专用 VX_gpr_if 接口，并把 VX_opc_unit.sv 与 VX_operands.sv 都重连到这条路径上。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 即使一个寄存器读返回网络在体系结构上没有下游背压，中间的流水缓冲和响应 crossbar 仍然需要显式的 always-ready 接收端。如果 ready 被留空、浮空，或者依赖工具的隐式行为，那么有效的操作数响应就可能停住、消失，或者把未知握手状态传播回 collector 路径。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 寄存器读响应握手终止
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: operand collector 发起 GPR 读取，响应通过本应永久 ready 的中间缓冲或响应 crossbar 返回时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 移除响应流水线或 crossbar 上显式的 always-ready 终止，使 ready 变成未使用或不确定状态。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 移除显式 ready 接收端
portability_notes: 这适用于任何通过内部流式原语把寄存器 bank 响应返回给操作数收集器的路径。
当设计期望这些内部阶段是“接收端式”的、永不向响应路径施加背压时，最适合注入该故障。
无需修改寄存器 bank 的存储语义，只要破坏响应路径的握手终止即可重现该问题。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位把寄存器读响应返回到 operand collector 的内部流水缓冲或 crossbar。
找到那些理论上应始终 ready、因为下游不存在节流的输出。
删除或断开这些阶段上的显式 ready 常量连接，使其不再看到 always-ready 的接收端。
保持请求生成和存储阵列读取逻辑不变，让故障表现为响应缺失或卡住。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: GPR 响应流水线和响应 crosspoint 的握手终止
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 VX_gpr_unit.sv 中把响应 pipe buffer 和响应 crosspoint 的 ready_out 都显式接到 '1，同时把该路径迁移到专用 VX_gpr_if 接口上。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: 移除响应阶段上的 always-ready 连接
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 hw/rtl/core/VX_gpr_unit.sv 中，把 pipe_reg1.ready_out 和 rsp_xpoint.ready_out 从 '1 改回未连接或未使用状态。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: operand collector 会收不到部分寄存器值、无限等待响应，或看到不稳定的响应握手，从而组装出错误操作数。
evidence_for_injection: 两个被修复的 ready_out 都位于 GPR bank 返回 collector 的响应路径上。
该提交没有改变 RAM 中保存的数据内容，而是改变了响应传输语义。
专用 VX_gpr_if 的引入也说明设计者在隔离一条专门的寄存器读请求和响应通道。
notes: 接口重命名只是辅助上下文；主要可回注的故障是响应阶段缺少 always-ready 终止。
由于接口清理噪声与修复混在一起，置信度保守设为 medium。
